# 004 — Replace the job scheduler with a hosted one
**Date** 2026-10-12 · **Status** accepted · **Supersedes** [[002-job-scheduler]] and ADR 003 · **Decided by** founder

**Context.** On the shop laptop the scheduler stops whenever the laptop sleeps.

**Decision.** Move the timetable to the hosted scheduler.
The old one is switched off after one week.

**Consequences.** One less machine to look after. Costs a flat monthly fee.
